Class OverrideResolver

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.generator.OverrideResolver
@Internal public final class OverrideResolver extends Object
Resolves the signature a declared method takes as source when it overrides a generic inherited method with that method's erased signature: the inherited parameter and return types with the type arguments of the supertype substituted.

A model written for bytecode overrides with the erased form, which the verifier accepts, such as Object get() for Supplier<String>; source only overrides with the substituted one. How much of it depends on the language: Java accepts erased parameters and a raw type for a parameterized one, and needs the substitution where an erasure changes or a return type is a type variable; Kotlin has no raw types and matches parameters exactly, so it needs the whole substituted signature.

Since:
2.3

    • recordComponentType

      public static @Nullable TypeDef recordComponentType(RecordDef recordDef, PropertyDef property, GenerationScope scope, boolean exact)
      The type a record component is written with, where the accessor it implies overrides a generic inherited method with the erasure of that method's signature: an Object value of a record implementing T value() of a Source<String> is a String value. Java requires the accessor of a component to return the type of the component, so the accessor is narrowed by narrowing the component.
      Parameters:
      recordDef - The record
      property - The component
      scope - The scope of the file being written
      exact - Whether the source language overrides with the substituted types only
      Returns:
      The type, or null where the component is written as the model declares it
